inputText: This is Final Tsadi — TSAH-dee so-FEET. Sound: same TS sound as Tsadi, used only at the end of a word. Shape hook: the same hockey stick with no blade: the shaft drops straight through the floor, branch still leaning on it. Tip: Same leaning branch as Tsadi, but no foot along the baseline; not Final Nun, Final Kaf, Tsadi.
